set.title: 🦊 Sussurro · Settings
set.ollamaHint: Local Ollama needs no key (URL http://localhost:11434/v1); other providers use their OpenAI-compatible URL.
set.personaHint: Edit the text below to customize the character. {{userName}} is replaced with the name above, {{petName}} with the pet's name. Takes effect immediately.
set.sysVoiceFallback: System-voice fallback (what to speak when TTS engine is unavailable)
set.refAudio: Reference audio (clone voice, empty = server default)
set.speakJa: 🗣 Japanese voice mode: UI text stays Chinese, speech is translated to Japanese (with local JP fine-tuned voice)
set.gsvRestarting: ⏳ Restarting — first model load takes 1–2 minutes…
set.gsvOk: ✅ Restarted successfully, Japanese voice is ready
set.gsvTimeout: ❌ Restart failed: service not ready in time (see tts.log)
set.gsvSynthFail: ❌ Server started but test synthesis failed (see tts.log)
set.gsvDisabled: Japanese TTS service is disabled or misconfigured
set.gsvNoPath: Engine path not found (fresh install, not configured): set Python path & server script in voice settings
set.walkingOpt: 🚶 Desktop walking (strolls along the taskbar, sometimes hops onto a desktop window to sit; pauses while dragging; Spine mode only)
set.featDesktopIcons: 🧩 Desktop icon awareness (experimental): read-only access to desktop icon positions (local only, never uploaded) so she can stand/sit on desktop icons; requires "Desktop level" display mode
set.autoLaunch: 🖥️ Start with Windows (combine with "Start hidden" for silent tray launch)
set.focusMode: 🎯 Focus/Away mode (stays quiet while you're away/idle, greets you on return)
set.weatherOn: Enable weather (she occasionally reports; shown in info panel)
set.weatherProvider: Provider (open-meteo no key; openweathermap needs key; devs can register custom)
set.weatherKey: Provider API Key (leave empty for open-meteo)
set.onboard1: Enter a chat API Key (Settings→Chat API→Test→Save)
set.onboard2: Click the fox and send a message
set.onboard3: (Optional) Turn on voice so she can speak
set.spineHint: 💡 Easy skins: create one folder per skin under your user data assets/spine/user/ directory (e.g. myskin/) with .atlas+.skel(or .json)+.png, restart — they appear in tray 🧩 Character Skin menu; avoid # in file names
set.agentTitle: 🤝 Agent API (other AIs / scripts call her)
set.audHint: (Japanese GSV pipeline with live playback-parameter simulation; requires Japanese voice mode + GSV)
set.toneTitle: Voice enable (off = that emotion falls back to default voice/tone):
set.seatSink: Seat sink depth (how far the legs dangle into the taskbar)
set.standSink: Standing feet trim (neg=raise, pos=sink; tune per skin, 0=default)
set.agentWord: Custom invoke word (when set, /chat must start with it, e.g. "Sussurro")
set.netProxy: Network proxy (in-app updates/weather; empty = follow system. e.g. http=127.0.0.1:7897)
set.agentHint: Other agents/scripts can call: POST http://127.0.0.1:8765/chat with {"text":"Sussurro help me…"}; GET /health for status. Listens on localhost only, not exposed to LAN.
set.taskHint: Task mode (/zcode prefix controls the PC) is off by default: open config.json, set zcodeEnabled to true and configure zcodeCli path (ZCode must be installed).
set.logdiagHint: Shows recent runtime log (tts.log): red = error (needs attention), yellow = warning (self-healed). Export is auto-sanitized (keys, URL params, username in paths, window titles, precise coordinates, PIDs, nicknames) and safe to share.
set.dirtyPartial: ⚠ Some sections failed to save, check their hints
set.fixedOnlyHint: 🔋 Fixed-line offline mode: local voice engines shut down to free VRAM; cached fixed lines keep playing, uncached ones are not synthesized on the fly (falls back to system voice)
set.fixedPoolHint: Generates for the current voice profile only; cached audio is kept indefinitely (space is reclaimed LRU-style when over budget). Cloud voices may incur API costs. System voice needs no preload.
set.fixedNeedPool: Please select at least one line pool
set.fixedStarting: Generating line by line with the current voice; finished items are kept…
set.fixedRetryErrors: Retry finished, but some items still failed
set.fixedCancelRequested: Pause requested; stops after the current audio finishes.
set.fixedClearConfirm: Clears the fixed-line audio cache of the current voice profile only; chat history and memory are kept. Continue?
set.fixedClearOldConfirm: Cleans old-version line caches left by previous voices/languages; the current profile cache is kept. Continue?
set.fixedOnlyStopping: Stopping voice engines and freeing VRAM…
set.fixedOnlyOn: Offline mode on: only cached fixed lines are spoken
set.fixedOnlyOff: Offline mode off: engines are back to work
set.renameCacheWarn: User name changed: fixed-line voices are cached per name, so affected lines will be regenerated (time and API cost depend on the voice profile). Save anyway?
set.upToDate: You are on the latest version ✅
set.updateReadyRestart: Update ready — the app will restart to finish updating ✅
set.updateDeclined: Update skipped (you can check again anytime)
set.updateAutoCheckHint: Checks for new versions silently every 24 hours
tray.updateRestarting: Update ready — restarting to finish updating…

page.settings.title: Sussurro · Settings
set.credNoticeA: ℹ️ Older versions may have read local ZCode / DashScope credentials at startup. This is now
set.credNoticeC: : the app no longer accesses external credentials implicitly. Credentials are copied into this app's secure storage only after you import them below, and used only for the corresponding service calls.
set.renderTitle: 🖼 Render Mode (pick a mode first; its options appear below)
set.rmRig: PSD 2.5D Character (auto-assembled, import a skin first)
set.rmHint: Sections below follow the selected render mode: Spine shows walking/model options, 2.5D shows character/follow options, GIF is the classic sprites.
set.live2dLabel: 🎭 Live2D Model (click to apply, no save needed):
set.live2dScaleNote: (applies live while in Live2D render mode)
set.rigHint: Drop a PSD into 🧩 PSD Character Tool → "Apply to Pet" to import; switch via tray "🎬 2.5D Skins"
set.expMouseTrack: 🖱️ Global mouse tracking: she keeps watching your cursor (computed locally, never uploaded). For the "being watched" feeling; off by default.
set.expCatToy: 🐈 Cat toy: a little toy — she chases your cursor when on (local only, never uploaded). Off by default.
set.expWalkGlobal: 🌍 Global desktop walking (experimental): she can stroll onto another monitor (multi-monitor joy). Off by default; observe for a day or two first.
set.expSoftRender: 🖥 Software rendering (for missing GPU / flaky drivers): draws with CPU — slower but steadier. Takes effect after restart.
set.proactiveLabel: 🗣️ Proactive chat: ignored for a while, she comes to talk to you (remembering your birthday/plans). On by default.
set.personifyLabel: 💗 Personality: thrown / woken up / perched / caught — she mutters like a living creature. On by default (head-pat unaffected).
set.rpLabel: 🎭 Roleplay (RP): on = she chats in a companion/roleplay tone (human-like, occasionally cheeky); off = assistant mode, obedient and concise, fewer pet names. On by default.
set.memoryDesc: What she remembers (titles/likes/birthday/health/recent plans; stored locally, encrypted, never uploaded). Updates naturally in chat, or delete/clear entries here.
set.memAddPh: Add a memory manually, e.g. I like coffee (max 120 chars)
set.smpNote: (local = Ollama/localhost applies Min P/rep. penalty; remote = top_p + frequency)
set.agentTokenLabel: Agent Bearer Token (empty = legacy compatibility; once set, every request must carry Authorization: Bearer)
set.agentSecHint: Security note: port, switch, token and body limit take effect after restart. With a token set, local scripts must send Authorization: Bearer <Token> on every request.
set.agentStatusEnabled: 🔧 Task status display (anti-hallucination): during zcode tasks the bubble shows real progress (task text + timer, no invented percentages); authorized clients can query GET /status.
set.agentClientsLabel: 🤝 Clients (authorized callers; "Disconnect" revokes their token immediately)
set.agentClientPh: Client name, e.g. my script / ZCode
set.wsWatch: 🧐 Workspace awareness: she murmurs while you code (read-only file watching, never uploaded)
set.wsWatchDirsLabel: Watched directories (semicolon/comma separated; empty = default ZCode workspace)
set.fileGuard: 🛡️ Honeytoken monitor: detects other programs touching my sensitive config areas (config/keys/history files) and alerts (cannot show process names with normal permissions)
set.clearAgentTokenTitle: After clearing and restarting, Agent API returns to empty-token compatibility mode (local scripts need no auth)
set.securityHint: Clearing only removes keys from this app's encrypted storage; no external app files are touched. After clearing the agent token and restarting, it returns to "empty-token compatibility mode" (old scripts on 127.0.0.1 still work).
set.importCredTitle: Explicit import from other local apps
set.importCredHint: Confirmation: importing copies credentials from the selected local source into this app's Windows DPAPI-protected storage, used only for the matching service calls. Originals are never displayed, modified or uploaded; source files stay unchanged.
set.credSourceLabel: Importable credentials (scan shows fingerprints only, never full keys)

page.help.title: Sussurro Help
page.help.sub: Rhodes Island medical operator · your desktop pet (v1.1)
page.help.qsBanner: 🐣 First time? Read the Quick Start tutorial (how to get an API key, what to do when things break)
page.help.qs1: "⚙️ Settings" → pick a provider (DeepSeek / Kimi / OpenAI / local Ollama…) → enter API key → "Test Connection" → "Save"
page.help.qs2: In Settings, change "what the pet calls you" to a name you like (auto-substituted into the persona)
page.help.qs3: Click the fox to open the input box, press Enter to send; edit the persona in "⚙️ Settings" → "Persona"
page.help.d1: Open / close the input bar (chat box)
page.help.d5: Click to hide/show; right-click for Settings / Help / Voice Deployment / Reload Persona / Exit
page.help.c1: Everyday chat — Sussurro answers in a Rhodes Island medic's tone
page.help.c3: Remembers recent conversation turns (adjustable in Settings)
page.help.v1b: Quickly click the fox twice within 2 seconds
page.help.v1: = head pat: she happily responds (❤ + line + animation). Single click still toggles the chat box
page.help.v2: Thrown / woken / perched on a window / caught — she mutters something, like she's alive (Settings → "💬 Proactivity & Personality" to toggle)
page.help.v3: Ignore her long enough and she starts the conversation; lines vary by time of day (Settings → "💬 Proactivity & Personality" to toggle)
page.help.v4: While other AIs/scripts work through her local API, she quietly keeps you company with occasional comments (no setup)
page.help.s1: Voice off; the pet chats via text bubbles with nothing extra to install
page.help.s2: Tray → "🎤 Voice Deployment & Training" for the guide, then pick a plan (system voice zero-config / edge-tts / local cloned voice / CosyVoice)
page.help.s3: One-click voice toggle on the input bar
page.help.note: 💡 Tip: without an API key, the settings window opens automatically on first launch; skin/persona changes need no restart — tray "Reload Persona" applies instantly.
page.terms.title: Sussurro · Terms & Privacy Policy
page.terms.footHint: Clicking "Agree" confirms acceptance of all terms
page.moods.title: Sussurro · Mood Manager
page.moods.sub: One card per emotion: click "Choose GIF" to use your own sprites, "Restore default" anytime.
page.moods.subB: The bundled defaults remain Sussurro's original sprites
page.moods.subC: — one click restores them if anything breaks.
page.moods.noteC: : edit the emotion name directly (≤5 chars), the GIF file stays; "Set as emotion" = the AI may use it in chat, "Set as idle" = used in the idle loop. All changes apply immediately.
page.moods.customHint: Missing an emotion? Add your own (≤5 chars, up to 30 total), e.g. "slacking", "eating", "sleepy" — then pick a GIF and the AI will use it at the right time.
page.voice.title: Sussurro · Voice Clone & Train
page.voice.sub: Clone Sussurro's voice from one reference audio clip — fully in-app, no command line
page.voice.sec1HintA: How it works: GPT-SoVITS mimics the reference audio's voice and tone. The cleaner and more conversational the clip, the better the clone.
page.voice.sec1HintB: 3–10 s, single speaker, no background music
page.voice.phFilePath: None selected (sample audio: Voice Deployment Guide\example_audio\ref_sussurro.wav)
page.voice.labelRefText: Reference transcript (must match the audio word for word)
page.voice.labelPreview: Preview text (synthesized with the voice above; listen before applying)
page.voice.applyHint: "Apply voice" sets the reference audio as the server default and saves it — the pet will speak with this voice; you can change it anytime.
page.voice.notDeployed: ⚠ Local Genie voice is not deployed. Follow "Open deployment guide" below first (install Python → genie-tts → download models), then come back to clone in one click.
page.voice.sec2Hint: If zero-shot cloning isn't close enough, fine-tune GPT-SoVITS with a larger dataset of your own audio and convert to ONNX for the pet. Needs a GPU (or patience); see the training guide.
page.psd.title: Sussurro · PSD Character Tool
page.psd.dropMeta: Parse layers → flattened preview → export PNG (as static portrait/skin material)

page.psd.tipB: : drop a layered PSD in, inspect the layer tree, then per layer

Edited layers take effect together with "Apply to Pet".

page.quickstart.fill4b: → say hello in the input box → Enter — she replies 🎉
